sources.title: Pokémon Trading Card Game Rules — Scarlet & Violet Rulebook（effects of attacks end when the Pokémon is moved to the Bench or evolves）
sources.supportsZh: 攻击施加在宝可梦身上的效果，在这只宝可梦回到备战区（撤退、交换）或进化时消失。所以“防守宝可梦”的减伤效果只跟着当时的战斗宝可梦，换下场或进化就没有了。

sources.title: Stoutland — Sun & Moon 105/149（Ferocious Bellow）
sources.documentVersion: Official international card database; English card text cross-checked against the Rainier card database 2026-10-07 (pokemon.com page blocked automated reading)
sources.supportsZh: “During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon's attacks do 50 less damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).”：在对手的下个回合，防守宝可梦的招式伤害先减 50，再计算弱点和抵抗力。

sources.title: Lunatone — XY 63/146（Moonblast）
sources.documentVersion: Official international card database; English card text cross-checked against the Rainier card database 2026-10-07 (pokemon.com page blocked automated reading)
sources.supportsZh: 旧写法 “During your opponent's next turn, any damage done by attacks from the Defending Pokémon is reduced by 20 (before applying Weakness and Resistance).”，与上一条意思相同。Rainier 里这两种写法的提示语全部是 “before applying”。

dataContractZh: 新效果 reduce_attack_damage：target 只能是 OPPONENT_ACTIVE（攻击时的防守宝可梦），只接受 amount（10–1000，10 的倍数），只能在攻击的 AFTER_ATTACK 结算。
serverAuthorityZh: 服务器把持续效果 ATTACK_DAMAGE_PENALTY 挂在对方当时的战斗宝可梦上，拥有者是攻击方，到攻击方下个回合开始时失效；换下场、进化时随其他攻击效果一起清除。这只宝可梦之后攻击时，伤害在攻击方持续修正之后、弱点和抵抗力之前减去这个数（不低于 0）；对备战宝可梦造成的攻击伤害同样减少。“防止攻击效果”的防护可以挡住这个效果的施加。
limitations: 特性写法 “As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks do N less damage” 是持续被动效果，不用本组件。
攻击者对自己造成的伤害（自伤）不减少。
